name: Know Christ
source:
A body chopper who lives in Sodom. Because of his weakness, he is at the bottom of the hierarchy and thus cruelly exploited, as are all weak people in Sodom. In order to take care of his (non blood-related) sister [url=https://vndb.org/c35150]Sofia[/url], he sells drugs at night, being one of the bottommost members of Infinite Viper. Alas, he does not get enough money from just selling drugs. Therefore, he, as a widely despicable "body chopper", sells parts of his body one by one and gets shabby prostheses instead.

One day, Death Seize caused problems for Infinite Viper, so there was a rumor that even the bottommost members would be sent for him. Know decides to find and defeat Death Size before that, in order to get a better position in Infinite Viper and get a solid foundation to support Sofia in the future.

Little did he know, what cruelties fate had in store for him...
